name: New screen design reviewer
why: Checks a new screen against the team's own design rules before it ships, a useful second look after the screen build skill.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Keeps accessibility checks and re-checks on a schedule, the same habit the accessibility pass applies to app screens.

name: Error message rewriter
why: Rewrites error messages in plain words with a next step, ready for the error and offline states in a screen's state table.

name: Bug evidence plan writer
why: Ranks likely causes with one quick check each before code changes, the same order the crash triage prompt follows.

name: Private bug evidence assistant
why: Turns a tester's notes and screenshots into a bug report with personal data masked, useful for TestFlight and internal test feedback.

name: Fix a bug with proof and a clear pull request
why: Proves the cause before fixing and ends in a small pull request, the right path for a screen that crashes or looks wrong.

name: Test failure repair loop
why: Fixes a failing test suite in capped rounds without loosening tests, handy after a React Native or Flutter upgrade.

name: Launch a feature through a beta and read the numbers
why: Plans a beta with metrics set in advance and release notes, a good fit for TestFlight and Play testing tracks.

name: Release day rollback planner
why: Writes the checks, pause points and way back for a release, the thinking behind a halt rule for a staged rollout.

name: Check a release and its docs
why: Finds test gaps and stale help pages before a release, so store notes and in-app help match the new version.

name: Weekly product feedback triager
why: Tallies and rules on feature requests each week, useful for sorting app store reviews and tester feedback.

name: Connect Code to Supabase coding prompt
why: Connects an app back end to Supabase with scoped access and safe secrets, a common data source for small apps.

name: Find leaked keys, secure them and check your live site
why: Finds keys committed to a repo and moves them to safe storage, for when an API key ended up in app code or a build config.
